what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 4: The inertial record gas beyond the Euler scale: viscosity and the damping of sound. SETTING (blocks 43 and 44; open PRs titled 'ail43: the fields of the record layer arrive by diffusion' and 'ail44: records with inertia'): block 43 showed that the two fields found in the record layer settle by a random walk (a distance R costs about R^2 ticks), so a carrier of a long-range field needs a speed. BLOCK 44's CLAUSE (supplied, not adopted): a record's content is its direction of travel. (S) each record at rate 1 tries to step along its content (six-axis menu: to x + e_d; sphere menu: to x + e_k with probability max(0, s.e_k)/sqrt 3); an empty target is entered; an occupied target exchanges contents with the record (the two pass through each other); a solid site reflects it. (C) each bond at rate gamma re-draws the contents of its two records uniformly on their momentum class (six axes: an opposite pair becomes a uniformly random opposite pair, any other pair is exchanged with probability 1/2; sphere: P/2 +- r w, w uniform on the unit circle orthogonal to P = s + s', r^2 = 1 - |P|^2/4). PROVED: number of records and momentum (sum of the contents' unit vectors) are conserved by every event; the clause is covariant; the UNIFORM measure is stationary (every record has exactly one streaming preimage; the scattering kernel is symmetric), also with reflecting bodies, and NOT if blocked attempts do nothing or if head-on pairs scatter when an attempt is blocked; in product states the mass current is (1 - rho) g and the pressure is exactly rho/3, so the linearized Euler speed squared is (1 - rho)/3 (six axes) and (1 - rho)/9 (sphere); in equilibrium the mean force on a reflecting body is exactly zero. EXECUTED: standing waves oscillate at 0.467 vs 0.483 (six axes) and 0.277 vs 0.279 (sphere) at density 0.3; bodies that CAPTURE records attract each other; bodies that emit records were also measured. The simulators are probes/lib/inertial.py (both menus: tick6, tick_s, sound) and probes/lib/inertial_bodies.py (two bodies in the sphere-menu gas: usage inertial_bodies.py L rho0 radius separation Q ticks seed gamma [absorb] [single]). TASK: block 44 measured the damping of standing waves (sphere menu, density 0.3, gamma = 1: 0.0030 per tick at wavelength 64 and 0.0130 at wavelength 32, i.e. proportional to k^2 with coefficient about 0.31; six axes: 0.0140 and 0.0480). (a) From the clause, derive the sound attenuation coefficient Gamma (damping = Gamma k^2 / 2) in the Boltzmann-type closure: the relaxation of the momentum flux tensor by the scattering (C) at rate gamma and by streaming with exchange, the shear and bulk viscosities, and the diffusive (non-Galilean) corrections due to the factor (1 - rho). (c) State which part is exact and which is a closure. check.py: the linearized collision operator of (C) on the six-axis menu as an exact 6 x 6 (one-site) and 36 x 36 (pair) matrix, its eigenvalues and conserved modes.
